Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 28, "heading": "CHAPTER XXVI", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u028-r0014", "target": "— Да, да, — быстро перебил Фрэнсис. — Был один человек, которого он нанимал чаще всех, молодой человек из Пинкертонов… ты помнишь его имя?", "source_sha256": "c903ca4f6e7c9faefe0e19e1f0de7fbaa3a71328c2beb94372491cfcef3d52c6", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u028-r0014", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "0174e51f55af3b994ee87f663b09bdfb79f0bda897ba082d54f822a784ea2bc3"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u028-r0015", "target": "— Бёрчман, сэр, — тотчас ответил Паркер, направляясь к двери. — Я пошлю за ним, чтобы он пришёл немедленно.", "source_sha256": "9bd974bc8dfcb1417f14cca3b71f7bd211bf757569e6adba112134b159b185d1", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u028-r0015", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c839fff18401760cffbc4261a52c02c50e942a6089d466bf3badf389ea5f4602"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u028-r0016", "tag": "p", "text": "And thereupon, in the quest after his wife, Francis entered upon a series of adventures that were to him, a born New Yorker, a liberal education in conditions and phases of New York of which, up to that time, he had been profoundly ignorant. Not alone did Birchman search, but he had at work a score of detectives under him who fine-tooth-combed the city, while in Chicago and Boston, he directed the activities of similar men.", "sha256": "bc779cc1732a0452bcc1870fb7de7ca382f30e7f3c4b57727c0ae97fffa9656d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2398]", "source_html": "

And thereupon, in the quest after his wife, Francis entered upon a series of adventures that were to him, a born New Yorker, a liberal education in conditions and phases of New York of which, up to that time, he had been profoundly ignorant. Not alone did Birchman search, but he had at work a score of detectives under him who fine-tooth-combed the city, while in Chicago and Boston, he directed the activities of similar men.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u028-r0017", "tag": "p", "text": "Between his battle with the unguessed enemy of Wall Street, and the frequent calls he received to go here and there and everywhere, on the spur of the moment, to identify what might possibly be his wife, Francis led anything but a boresome existence. He forgot what regular hours of sleep were, and grew accustomed to being dragged from luncheon or dinner, or of being routed out of his bed, to respond to hurry calls to come and look over new-found missing ladies. No trace of one answering her description, who had left the city by train or steamer had been discovered, and Birchman assiduously pursued his fine-tooth combing, convinced that she was still in the city.", "sha256": "a82cbe23552f57cab427ee5721217b107b56b74135ea922c83fa39da63dd8691", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2399]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u028-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "Thus, Francis took trips to Mattenwan and down Blackwell’s, and the Tombs and the All-Night court knew his presence. Nor did he escape being dragged to countless hospitals nor to the Morgue. Once, a fresh-caught shoplifter, of whom there was no criminal record and to whom there was no clew of identity, was brought to his notice. He had adventures with mysterious women cornered by Birchman’s satellites in the back rooms of Raines’ Hotels, and, on the West Side, in the Fifties, was guilty of trespassing upon two comparatively innocent love-idyls, to the embarrassment of all concerned including himself.", "sha256": "0404ece142a18ddf2a1a8a8da5ff3a4afe56da61803eec58b9676c2681687202", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2400]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u028-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "Perhaps his most interesting and tragic adventure was in the ten-million-dollar mansion of Philip January, the Telluride mining king. The strange woman, a lady slender, had wandered in upon the Januarys a week before, ere Francis came to see her. And, as she had heartbreakingly done for the entire week, so she heartbreakingly did for Francis, wringing her hands, perpetually weeping, and murmuring beseechingly: “Otho, you are wrong. On my knees I tell you you are wrong. Otho, you, and you only, do I love. There is no one but you, Otho. There has never been any one but you. It is all a dreadful mistake. Believe me, Otho, believe me, or I shall die....”", "sha256": "6331f5e8e065d48c98fc3b78efa7c327a89b2b84658d6d2cd235f8c8faf252f7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2401]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u028-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“If only we can avoid throwing Tampico Petroleum into the whirlpool,” Bascom prayed.", "sha256": "3060e4ab43911e62aec515cf4811a795e1f2a4e9106032a4d3b2d6855a7b6b68", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2403]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u028-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "“I look to Tampico Petroleum to save me,” Francis replied. “When every security I can lay hand to has been engulfed, then, throwing in Tampico Petroleum will be like the eruption of a new army upon a losing field.”", "sha256": "516ecc5ce36cb9deab44e27d5da1ab8de264fbd84a45218837299cf7b2918d65", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2404]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u028-r0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“Sweet sister,” had been his way, “we’re going to go up and see what the scoundrel Torres and his gang are doing. We do know, thanks to you, their objective. The dynamite is to blow an entrance into the Valley. We know where the Lady Who Dreams sank her treasure when her house burned. Torres does not know this. The idea is that we can follow them into the Valley, when they have drained the Maya caves, and have as good a chance, if not a better chance than they in getting possession of that marvelous chest of gems. And the very tip of the point is that we’d like to take you along on the expedition.
